title: Accessible planning

title: Authorization
normative_statement: Every Project dashboard query and mutation MUST enforce authentication, module entitlement, organization/company/project/team/record scope, action permission and server-side field visibility.

title: Sensitive fields
normative_statement: Customer contracts, employee allocations/time, costs/rates/margin, approvals and restricted documents/comments in Project dashboard MUST be field/action restricted and protected against IDOR, aggregate leakage and unauthorized export.

title: Automation boundary

title: Maker-checker

title: Notifications

title: Reporting

title: AI authority

title: Inbound contract

title: Outbound contract
